inlines.v: SLA'NDEROUS, adjective 1. That utters defamatory words or tales; as a slanderous tongue. 2. Containing slander or defamation; calumnious; as slanderous words, speeches or reports, false and maliciously uttered. 3. Scandalous; reproachful.
